title: Reasons in the Past: mert and the Past Tense

sections.title: Giving Reasons in the Past
sections.content: You know the past tense (A2 Unit 24) and *mert* ('because') from earlier units. To explain why people supported Rákóczi, put the reason after *mert*: *A jobbágyok követték Rákóczit, mert szabadságot akartak.* ('The serfs followed Rákóczi because they wanted freedom.').

items.spanish: Sok nemes elégedetlen volt, mert a bécsi udvar elvette a birtokaikat.
items.english: Many nobles were dissatisfied because the Viennese court had taken their estates.

items.spanish: Rákóczi 1703-ban fegyverbe szólította a népet, mert a nép nyomorban élt.
items.english: In 1703 Rákóczi called the people to arms because the people lived in misery.
